description: Kowal, the ghost of an underworld blacksmith, a huge muscular translucent pale green ghost in a leather apron with a long braided beard, holding a heavy smith's hammer in both hands in front of him, ready to strike, chains hanging from his belt, glowing green eyes, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the ghost alone, no anvil, no ground, no background, the whole figure and the whole hammer inside the picture, with space above the head
